يقتضبا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَضِبَا (yaqtaḍibā) /jaq.ta.dˤi.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# يُقْتَضَبَا (yuqtaḍabā) /juq.ta.dˤa.baː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
